name: Chemlite Innovation Berhad
overview: Chemlite Innovation Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE Market 上市，并设立长期激励计划（含 ESOS 与股份授予计划）。公司业务线未见扩张、缩减或出售的公告，亦无新合约披露。
overview_en: Chemlite Innovation Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia in 2026 and established a long-term incentive plan comprising an ESOS and a share grant scheme. No announcements were made on expansion, reduction or disposal of business lines, and no new contracts were disclosed.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年完成 IPO 上市，并推行长期激励计划；业务板块层面无具体动态公告。
segments.note_en: Completed its IPO listing this year and implemented a long-term incentive plan; no specific segment-level operational announcements.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE FOLLOWING:- (I) PROPOSED ESTABLISHMENT OF A LONG-TERM INCENTIVE PLAN COMPRISING AN EMPLOYEES' SH
actions.text: 包括员工股份期权计划（ESOS）及股份授予计划，合计不超过已发行股份总数的10.0%。
actions.text_en: Proposed establishment of a long-term incentive plan comprising an employees' share option scheme (ESOS) and a share grant scheme, of up to 10.0% of the total number of issued shares.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF AND QUOTATION FOR THE ENTIRE ENLARGED ISSUED ORDINARY SHARE CAPITAL OF CH
actions.text: 公司完成首次公开募股并在 Bursa Malaysia ACE Market 上市。
actions.text_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia.
